info.title: Graphly Plot Generator API
info.description: Enables external AI assistants (ChatGPT via GPT Actions) to generate shareable links for interactive 2D curves, 3D surfaces, and tabular data in Graphly.

post.summary: Generate a shareable Graphly plot link
post.description: Accepts a plot specification and returns a direct link opening Graphly with that exact graph loaded.

mode.description: Visual mode to open: 'function' for 2D curve, 'data' for tabular scatter/regression, '3d' for explicit surface.

expression.description: Mathematical formula for 2D curve (e.g. 'sin(x)', 'x^2 - 4') or 3D surface (e.g. 'sin(x) * cos(y)').

name.description: Optional title for the dataset or graph.

rows.description: Array of data point objects with numerical x and y values for Data Mode.

url.description: Direct clickable link that launches Graphly with the graph rendered.
